thread:
auditor_kate: Hi team — auditor asked for a compact proof bundle showing RBAC changes + KMS key usage for the 2025-02-10 window. They want the mapping: rolebinding diffs, who approved, KMS Encrypt/Decrypt logs, and any related incident tickets. Can we assemble and presign?

maria_sec: Ack. scope = prod only or includes staging?

auditor_kate: Prod only. 90 days back from 2025-02-10. Also they want the key policy snapshot at time of change (signed).

jon_infra: We can produce: CloudAudit export of IAM rolebinding diffs + approver comments from the change request, KMS key access events (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) from CloudTrail, and a key policy snapshot from the key management console. I can script an export.

jon_infra: Example query to pull KMS events: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-01-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-02-10T23:59:59Z --region us-west-2
```

ryan_oncall: FYI there was a vuln triage on 2025-01-22 that touched a service account change. Need to link that ticket (INC-7891) to the bundle. Auditor expects incident linkage if relevant.

maria_sec: Good catch. Jon — can you include a short CSV mapping: role_change_id, actor, approved_by, timestamp, ticket_id. That will make the auditor life easier.

jon_infra: Yep. Also adding a small proof file: signed SHA256 manifest of each artifact. We'll upload artifacts to a temporary S3 bucket and presign for the auditor.

jon_infra: Sample manifest line: `sha256:3a7f... 2025-01-22/rolebinding-diff.json`

maria_sec: For the key policy snapshot, we should include the ARN + full policy json and a timestamped export, plus a note if the key is EKM-backed or KMS-managed.

auditor_kate: They also asked whether we rotate keys automatically and if rotation events are recorded. A yes/no plus link to rotation log entries is fine.

jon_infra: Rotation is automatic for the envelope keys; master KEK is manual. I'll include rotation events query.

ryan_oncall: Quick triage note: while digging INC-7891 we found one role change executed by a bot user (`svc-deploy-bot`). Approval flow shows human approval via the change board (pull request + 2 approvers). I'll attach PR link.

maria_sec: Evidence-bot — can you create the top-level evidence index (json) with pointers to presigned URLs, manifest, and a short chain-of-custody note?

evidence-bot: Sure — creating evidence index now. Generated index id: evidence-20250210-01. Presigns expire in 7 days by default.

jon_infra: One more thing: auditor asked for log integrity assurance. We should include a note about log retention and our HMAC-of-archives process. Short snippet attached: 
```
# verify archive integrity
sha256sum -c archives-2025-01-*.sha256
```

maria_sec: Also prepare a short explanation doc (1 page) describing how RBAC changes flow: PR -> change review -> approve -> deploy job -> rolebinding apply. Attach screenshots of the PR and the approve history for the specific role_change_id.

auditor_kate: Perfect. Timeline needed: when rolebinding applied vs when key event occurred. If they overlap / causally related, they'll flag for follow-up.

jon_infra: I'll correlate timestamps and include a tiny timeline CSV with ISO8601 times.

maria_sec: Owners: jon_infra (exports + manifests), ryan_oncall (incident linkage + ticket context), maria_sec (narrative + PR screenshots). Auditor wants the bundle by EOD 2025-02-11.

auditor_kate: Thanks — can you post the presigned links back to this thread when ready? Prefer a single index.json link.

jon_infra: Will do. Starting export now, ping if we need extra scope. :thumbsup:

ryan_oncall: If anyone sees unexpected Encrypt/Decrypt counts during the window call it out — I will flag and provide runbook snapshot.

maria_sec: Noted. I'll also capture rolebinding delta with `kubectl` diff output for the clusters impacted.

jon_infra: ETA: 6 hours. I'll post index.json when uploads complete.

auditor_kate: Great, thanks everyone.
